description: Logical projects agent-fabric manages. A working copy is matched to a project by its origin remote (or a .agent-fabric-project marker at its toplevel), never by its directory name. `taxonomy` and `memory` are paths INSIDE the project's working copy (its .agent-fabric/); other paths here are repository-relative; machine-specific checkout locations live in each agent's runtime binding. `memory` is where the project's distilled knowledge lives INSIDE the project's working copy (fabric-coordinator's to write; every role reads it). `license` is the SPDX identifier the project's OWN tree carries — information about the project, not about anything here: this repository is Apache-2.0 throughout, projects/<id>/ included.

agent_env.OPENAI_API_KEY: OpenAI API key for scripts that call it directly (gzapp.decks image generation). One per login: a service account agent-fabric-<login> in the organisation's project (fabric-secrets provision issue-key openai, with the coordinator's admin key), so the Usage API reports spend per agent
agent_env.OPENROUTER_API_KEY: OpenRouter API key for the broker launch path (runtime/openrouter/launch). One per login, named after it (fabric-secrets provision issue-key openrouter, with the coordinator's provisioning key), so the dashboard reports spend per agent; never shared from another login's store
agent_env.SERPAPI_API_KEY: SerpAPI (serpapi.com) key for the locale search tool's located engine (web_search: Google's results with gl, hl, google_domain and lr from the locale; runtime/mcp/websearch-locale), read at call time into the api_key query parameter — SerpAPI's only auth — of a URL that is never logged. Only a language-culture login's store carries it (the CEO's account, 2026-09-17); every other login has no such name, and sync exports it only where it is set. Google's own Custom Search JSON API is closed to new customers (2026-09-17), which is why a SERP proxy
agent_env.BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY: Brave Search API key for the locale search tool's second engine (web_search_global), read at call time into one request header; the same login as the Google pair (the CEO: keep both engines, 2026-09-17)
agent_env.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN: Which Claude account this login's sessions run on: that account's one-year `claude setup-token` token (user:inference only), put into the login's store from the coordinator's template CLAUDE_ACCOUNT_<ACCOUNT> (ADR-038). Set, it outranks the login's own /login sign-in (measured 2026-09-24); moving a login to another account is this one entry, applied by the signed secrets-sync action (bin/fabric-accounts assign). Unset, the launcher refuses a plain-claude session. The accounts' usage windows are read by the coordinator's observer, not through this token (docs/adr/ADR-031-claude-accounts-assigned-applied-and-proved-by-signed-action.md)
agent_env.FABRIC_CONTROL_SIGNING_KEY: The host operator's Ed25519 key for signing control-plane ACTIONS (runtime/control/sign.mjs), one line `ed25519-pkcs8:<base64>`. Only the operator's own store carries it — made by `fabric-ctl keygen`, which writes it there on stdin and the public half to runtime/hosts/registry.json; every other login has no such name. A daemon answers an action (fabric-ctl … upgrade) only when signed with it.

agent_env.GZAPP_PORT_OFFSET: the port offset of this login's local stack (infra/local/port-offsets.tsv); exported by fabric-secrets sync, wins over .env.local and the table

kutaisi-shop-transit.title: Kutaisi shop-to-transit matching (OSM shops against bus/marshrutka lines)
kutaisi-shop-transit.note: A private repository whose tree carries no license file: all rights reserved by default. One role, domain-transit; its working copy is that account's (moved there 2026-09-15).

gzapi.ge.title: gzapi.ge — the company website (Gzapi LLC)
gzapi.ge.note: Static Astro site, vision-level by rule, ka/en. The brand's source of truth: where a deck and the site disagree on a token or a phrase, the site wins (owner, 2026-09-15). One role, brand-comms. A private repository whose tree carries no license file: all rights reserved by default. Moved to gzapi-org on 2026-09-16; the andreabenetton spellings stay listed for clones not yet re-pointed.

gzapi.brand.title: gzapi.brand — the brand's source of authority
gzapi.brand.note: Names, claims by audience, the brand subset of the design tokens, the asset register and the decision records; no code, no build. The brand's source of authority since the owner's decision of 2026-09-17 (brand/decisions/0001), superseding the 2026-09-15 ruling that gzapi.ge was: the site, the decks and the product's shared web tokens copy the brand subset at a pinned commit and record it. One role, brand-comms; the owner decides, brand-comms proposes. A private repository whose tree carries no licence file; registered by fabric-coordinator on 2026-09-17.

gzapp.decks.title: gzapp.decks — brand presentation decks (Marp)
gzapp.decks.note: Marp decks under one brand theme whose tokens are vendored from gzapi.ge (the source of truth); bilingual, an asset register every image has a row in, PDFs as versioned build output. One role, brand-comms. A private repository whose tree carries no license file: all rights reserved by default; the vendored fonts are OFL-1.1. Moved to gzapi-org on 2026-09-16; the andreabenetton spellings stay listed for clones not yet re-pointed.

interweave.title: InterWeave — peer-to-peer transport for Claude Code Channels and first-party clients
interweave.note: A Rust workspace on libp2p: one PeerId, many EndpointIds, signed GossipSub broadcast, a directed protocol, replaceable discovery, Kademlia, AutoNAT v2 / Circuit Relay v2 / DCUtR. Worked by the owner's own login until 2026-09-17, when the CEO made it a managed project with one new role, p2p-network-dev (the code), architect-cto holding its decision records and stage gates, devex-tooling its CI. Its merge queue stays on (the owner, 2026-09-17).

agent-fabric-gateway.title: agent-fabric-gateway — the Rust data plane the fabric's sessions reach their models through
agent-fabric-gateway.note: The fabric is the control plane (identity, roles, capability policy, model selection); the gateway accepts harness-native API traffic, executes the route it is given and adapts only where it must (its ADR-001, ADR-014). Designed by the owner's own sessions until 2026-09-24, when the owner put the whole repository under fabric-coordinator: one owner for the control/data boundary, its decision records, its code and its CI.
